title: Water Shut Off Tonight Near Del Mar Boulevard and McPherson Road
excerpt: Laredo Utilities will shut off water from 9 p.m. Monday to 1 a.m. Tuesday near Del Mar Boulevard and McPherson Road to replace a valve, affecting Laredo Medical Center, hotels, restaurants and nearby businesses.
content:
The Laredo Utilities Department will shut off water Monday evening, Nov. 16, from 9 p.m. to 1 a.m. to replace a valve near Del Mar Boulevard and McPherson Road, according to KGNS.

Lane closures on Del Mar Boulevard will run from 6 p.m. to 1 a.m., according to the report.

Properties affected include Laredo Medical Center, hotels, restaurants and businesses near the intersection, and some may experience a temporary loss of water pressure, according to the report.

After service is restored, water may be discolored or brownish, according to the report. Residents should flush their taps and avoid washing clothes until the water runs clear.

Source: KGNS, November 16, 2026.
